summary.text: Bob Freeman is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 136 who has served since December 1, 1998 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Listed on Ballotpedia as Robert Freeman, he also served in the Pennsylvania House from 1983 to 1994.

paragraphs.text: Bob Freeman earned a B.A. from Moravian College in 1978 and an M.A. in history from Lehigh University in 1984.
His professional experience includes working as a shop steward.
Ballotpedia lists Freeman's earlier service in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives as running from 1983 to 1994.
For the 2023-2024 session, it lists him as chair of the House Local Government Committee.
